item.title: Weekend snow covers landscape
item.description: The snowfall started around lunchtime Saturday, with projections of between 1-2 inches of snow in Candler County. The snow-covered skies yielded a blistery cold day Sunday, with nighttime temperatures plummeting into the teens. The beautiful snow-covered landscape did not last long, and by Sunday afternoon, despite the colder temperatures, most traces of snow were melting away under the bright sunshine.
